_doc: The authored continent (design/map/continent-11, approved by the user 2026-11-13/14), exported by tools/design/map/export_continent.py; do not edit by hand, edit the design data and re-export. regions: id, name, holder (great sect key), centre tile, size, neighbours, biome shares. great_sects / minor_sects: key, names, tier or lord, leans, seat (place id). places: id, kind, tile [x, y] on the 540 x 360 grid (25 km tiles), region, holder and territory (great sect keys), land flags, names (holder: the great or minor sect key holding the place,  for an unheld wild site); sacred places follow the 204 settled and wild ones. routes: a, b (place ids, a < b), kind road | trunk | lane, length in tiles and km, and cost: Travel & Map Formula D's sum of c_t along the route (road tiles 1 + r_share x (c_wild - 1) from the tile's biome mix, sea 1; ContinentData.trip_seasons divides it by the mode's speed). grid_file: the tile grid (ContinentGrid; the layers are listed in the exporter); legend: biome ids and feature bits as the grid stores them. arrays: the teleport-array cities. origins: the origin home choices (approved); origin_homes: per origin id, the place ids a character of that origin may start at. Each place also carries density, danger and qi (Travel & Map Formula C, tools/design/map/land_qi.py: the tile part it reads, its biome, the five base shares summing to 100, variants outside the 100, land density and land danger before the kind's offset and settlement cut); qi_file: the per-tile-part qi layer (S<k><el>, V<k><el> shares x 100, DEN<k> density x 1000, DAN<k> danger, k = 1..3 the tile's parts); mu: Formula A's world mean shares over places.

places.name: Yên Ba Thành
places.note: Thôi Hiệu, Hoàng Hạc Lâu: yên ba giang thượng sử nhân sầu (mist on the river waves makes one sad); the haze of Thúy Vi

places.name: Hàn Tân Thành
places.note: The northern ford and port of the cold coast

places.name: Tùng Gian Thành
places.note: Vương Duy: minh nguyệt tùng gian chiếu (the bright moon shines among the pines)

places.name: Đào Thanh Thành
places.note: The pine waves of Tùng Đào Cung, heard from the city below its seat

places.name: Khai Dương Thành
places.note: Khai Dương (Mizar), a star of the Northern Dipper like Thiên Xu

places.name: Trường Vân Thành
places.note: Vương Xương Linh, Tòng Quân Hành: Thanh Hải trường vân ám tuyết sơn (long clouds darken the snow mountains); the same poet as Băng Tâm

places.name: Liên Giang Thành
places.gloss: City Where the Rain Meets the River
places.note: Vương Xương Linh: hàn vũ liên giang dạ nhập Ngô (cold rain joins the river by night), the first line of the Băng Tâm poem

places.name: Đàm Ảnh Thành
places.note: Vương Bột, Đằng Vương Các: nhàn vân đàm ảnh nhật du du (idle clouds and their reflections in the pool, day after day)

places.name: Nhạn Thanh Thành
places.gloss: City of the Wild Geese's Cry
places.note: Vương Bột: nhạn trận kinh hàn (the wild geese in formation, startled by the cold)

places.name: Tử Điện Thành
places.note: Vương Bột: tử điện thanh sương, Vương tướng quân chi vũ khố (the purple-lightning and blue-frost swords of General Vương's armoury)

places.name: Tinh Hán Thành
places.note: Tào Tháo, Quan Thương Hải: tinh Hán xán lạn, nhược xuất kỳ lý (the bright Milky Way seems to rise out of the sea); Thiên Xu's port on the inland sea

places.name: Lai Nghi Thành
places.note: Kinh Thư: Tiêu Thiều cửu thành, phượng hoàng lai nghi (when the Shao music was played nine times, the phoenix came)

places.name: Thu Trì Thành
places.note: Lý Thương Ẩn: Ba Sơn dạ vũ trướng thu trì (night rain on the mountain swells the autumn pools)

places.name: Không Mông Thành
places.note: Tô Thức: sơn sắc không mông vũ diệc kỳ (the hills hazy in the rain are lovely too)

places.name: Ngũ Thải Thành
places.note: Sơn Hải Kinh: the bird of Mount Đan Huyệt is five-coloured, the phoenix

places.name: Lam Yên Thị
places.note: Below Thúy Vi Tông's seat, in the haze that names it

places.name: Tùng Hạ Thị
places.note: Giả Đảo: tùng hạ vấn đồng tử (beneath the pine I asked the boy where his master was)

places.name: Đào Sa Thị
places.note: Lưu Vũ Tích, Lãng Đào Sa: after a thousand washings the sand gives up its gold; beside Lãng Đào Môn

places.name: Tống Khách Thị
places.note: Vương Xương Linh: bình minh tống khách (at dawn I see my guest off), the Băng Tâm poem

places.name: Tương Phùng Thị
places.note: Vương Bột: bình thủy tương phùng (duckweed and water meet by chance); beside Bình Thủy Môn

places.name: Vật Hoa Thị
places.note: Vương Bột: vật hoa thiên bảo (the riches of the land are heaven's treasures); beside Thiên Bảo Trai

places.name: Hạc Đinh Thị
places.note: Vương Bột: hạc đinh phù chử (crane shoals and wild-duck isles); below Lạc Hà Tông's seat

places.name: Thiên Quyền Thị
places.note: Thiên Quyền (Megrez), the Dipper star of authority and measure; below Thiên Xu Tông's seat

places.name: Thiều Âm Thị
places.note: The music that brings the phoenix; below Phượng Minh Cung's seat

places.name: Hạnh Hoa Thị
places.note: Lục Du: tiểu lâu nhất dạ thính xuân vũ, thâm hạng minh triều mại hạnh hoa (all night in the small tower I listened to the spring rain; tomorrow the lanes will sell apricot blossom); below Thính Vũ Lâu

places.name: Bích Ngọc Khoáng
places.note: Green stone from the green hills of Thúy Vi.

places.name: Vân Mẫu Khoáng
places.note: Mica, 'mother of clouds', for Vân Khởi Quán, the abbey of rising clouds.

places.name: Thạch Lục Khoáng
places.note: Malachite, the green of the pine sea, dug under the trees.

places.name: Băng Lăng Khoáng
places.note: Shafts hung with ice in the frost land of Hàn Sương Châu.

places.name: Xích Kim Khoáng
places.note: Gold the colour of Lạc Hà's sunset, for Thiên Bảo Trai's treasure market.

places.name: Thần Sa Khoáng
places.note: Cinnabar from the red badlands, the alchemists' first stone.

places.name: Lưu Hoàng Khoáng
places.note: Yellow sulphur crusts in the badlands near the wasteland.

places.name: Vẫn Tinh Khoáng
places.note: Iron from a star that fell on the high plain, for Củng Tinh Quán, whose stars bow to the Pivot.

places.name: Thiên Ngoại Khoáng
places.gloss: Mine of the Iron from Beyond the Sky
places.note: Thối Tinh Môn forges star iron, and says this is where it comes from.

places.name: Huyền Thiết Khoáng
places.note: Dark heavy iron under Ngọc Hành Sơn.

places.name: Can Tương Khoáng
places.note: Can Tương, the swordsmith of legend; Phất Y Cốc's swords are forged from its ore.

places.name: Bạch Ngân Khoáng
places.note: Silver below the cinnabar mountain of Đan Sơn Mạch.

places.name: Kinh Điện Khoáng
places.note: In Kinh Trập Sơn, where the storms strike the ore.

places.name: Tử Kim Khoáng
places.note: Purple-gold ore, the colour of storm light.

places.name: Vũ Hoa Khoáng
places.note: Rain-flower pebbles, said to be flowers that fell as rain while a master preached; the richest ground of the sixteen (land density 1.87). In Thính Vũ's land of rain.

places.name: Đan Thạch Khoáng
places.note: Red stone from the phoenix's cinnabar land, Đan Huyệt Châu.

places.name: Phụ Tinh Phong
places.note: Phụ tinh (Alcor), the faint star beside the Dipper

places.name: Trích Tinh Phong
places.gloss: Peak Where One Picks the Stars
places.note: Lý Bạch: thủ khả trích tinh thần (one could pluck the stars by hand); 4.7 km, the roof of the heartland

places.name: Hồi Lộ Phong
places.note: Sầm Tham, Bạch Tuyết Ca: sơn hồi lộ chuyển bất kiến quân (the mountain turns, the road bends, and you are gone)

places.name: Lăng Tuyệt Phong
places.note: Đỗ Phủ, Vọng Nhạc: hội đương lăng tuyệt đỉnh, nhất lãm chúng sơn tiểu (I shall stand on the very top and see all mountains small); 5.2 km, the highest on the continent

places.name: Thanh Ải Phong
places.note: Vương Duy, Chung Nam Sơn: thanh ải nhập khán vô (the blue haze, walked into, is gone)

places.name: Cùng Mục Phong
places.note: Vương Chi Hoán: dục cùng thiên lý mục, cánh thướng nhất tầng lâu (to see a thousand li further, climb one storey more)

places.name: Liệt Khuyết Phong
places.note: Lý Bạch, Mộng du Thiên Mỗ: liệt khuyết phích lịch, khâu loan băng thôi (lightning and thunder, and the ridges crumble)

places.name: Chúc Long Sơn
places.note: Sơn Hải Kinh: in the dark far north the Torch Dragon lights the world; a volcano on the ice

places.name: Sương Diễm Sơn
places.note: Fire under the frost of the north-east peninsula

places.name: Hạo Nguyệt Hồ
places.note: The long lake of Lãnh Nguyệt Lâm, the biggest on the continent; Hàm Nguyệt Trang holds its moon

places.name: Phiến Băng Hồ
places.gloss: Lake of the Piece of Ice
places.note: Vương Xương Linh: nhất phiến băng tâm (one piece of ice heart); beside Băng Tâm Các

places.name: Tinh Lạc Hồ
places.note: A high lake, 1.2 km up, that holds the Dipper at night; beside Củng Tinh Quán

places.name: Triêu Hà Hồ
places.note: The east's dawn clouds answer Lạc Hà's sunset clouds in the west; beside Lễ Tuyền Phái

places.name: Tàn Hà Hồ
places.note: Lý Thương Ẩn: lưu đắc khô hà thính vũ thanh (keep the withered lotus, to listen to the rain); beside Thính Vũ Lâu

places.name: Phù Chử Đảo
places.note: Vương Bột: hạc đinh phù chử (crane shoals and wild-duck isles)

places.name: Tịch Chiếu Đảo
places.note: The westernmost island, last to see the sunset of Lạc Hà

places.name: Tương Phi Đảo
places.note: Its spotted bamboo, stained by the tears of the two consorts of Thuấn

places.name: Dục Nhật Đảo
places.note: Sơn Hải Kinh: in the far south-east the suns bathe in the sea before they rise

places.name: Đồ Nam Đảo
places.note: Trang Tử: the great Bằng rises ninety thousand li, then sets out for the south

places.name: Phản Cảnh Lâm
places.note: Vương Duy, Lộc Trại: phản cảnh nhập thâm lâm (the evening light comes back into the deep forest); the heart of the northern forest

places.name: Vô Tung Lâm
places.note: Liễu Tông Nguyên, Giang Tuyết: vạn kính nhân tung diệt (on ten thousand paths, no human trace)

places.name: Đả Diệp Lâm
places.note: Tô Thức: xuyên lâm đả diệp thanh (rain piercing the forest, beating the leaves), the line of Xuyên Lâm Môn nearby

places.name: Viên Đề Hạp
places.note: Lý Bạch: lưỡng ngạn viên thanh đề bất trú (on both banks the gibbons cry without end)

places.name: Vạn Trùng Hạp
places.note: Lý Bạch: khinh chu dĩ quá vạn trùng sơn (the light boat has passed ten thousand mountains)

places.name: Tinh Tủy Mạch
places.note: A wild vein high in Dao Quang Lĩnh, near Trích Tinh Phong, 4 tiles from Băng Tâm's border.

places.name: Thương Tùng Mạch
places.note: A wild vein under the old pine sea, 4 tiles from Thiên Xu's border.

places.name: Trường Hà Mạch
places.note: Vương Duy: trường hà lạc nhật viên, the long river and the round setting sun. On the border with Thính Vũ.

places.name: Kinh Lôi Mạch
places.note: In Kinh Trập Sơn, the mountains of the thunder that wakes the sleepers; within reach of the storm peaks, so it carries Thunder. 5 tiles from Thiên Xu's border.

places.name: Băng Phách Mạch
places.note: Băng phách, the ice soul, is an old name for the moon. Under the ice mountains of Ngọc Hồ Sơn, within reach of the storm peaks.

places.name: Hỏa Ngọc Mạch
places.note: Under a volcano on an island off Tuyết Hỏa Giác, far out in the western sea, where Lạc Hà's waters begin.

places.name: Đan Sơn Mạch
places.note: Sơn Hải Kinh's cinnabar mountain is where the phoenix is born. 3 tiles from Thiên Xu's border.

places.name: Cao Cương Phong
places.note: Kinh Thi: phượng hoàng minh hĩ, vu bỉ cao cương, the phoenix sings on that high ridge. A sacred summit (Light).

places.name: Không Sơn Viện
places.note: Left empty after its master gave the hills to Thúy Vi's founder; quiet and never looted.

places.name: Hồ Thiên Phái
places.note: Buried by the eruption of Chúc Long Sơn under the ice.

places.name: Xích Thành Môn
places.note: The red-cliff gate Phượng Minh destroyed under Thiên Xu's writ.

places.name: Hàn Giang Môn
places.note: The fishers' sect of the frost coast, conquered by Băng Tâm.

places.name: Thôn Hải Môn
places.note: The pirates' hold on an islet of the southern gulf.

places.name: Phá Quân Môn
places.note: The mountain fort of the vassal that rebelled against Thiên Xu.

places.name: Kim Cốc Thành
places.note: Kim Cốc Viên's merchant city, burned in the crash of 1003.

places.name: Vân Môn Thành
places.note: Cửu Thiều's city, named for the ancient Vân Môn music, twin of the Thiều; abandoned after the War of the Nine Shao.

places.name: Lôi Trạch Thành
places.note: Khải Lôi's river-mouth city, burned by the lightning of Hầu Xuân Lôi's tribulation.

places.name: Hồng Vũ Thành
places.note: Lý Hạ: peach petals falling like red rain. Lạc Anh's city on the Petal Shore, burned in the war over its land.

places.name: Vô Định Thành
places.gloss: City of the Vô Định River
places.note: Trần Đào: the bones by the Vô Định river that wives still dream of. Burned in the battle of 803 and left to the miasma.

places.name: Đông Lưu Thành
places.note: Lý Bạch: all things since ancient times flow east like water. A mortal town left dry when the river changed its course.

places.name: Hổ Khiếu Trấn
places.note: A forest town overrun by a beast tide.

places.name: Bích Không Cảng
places.note: Lý Bạch: the lone sail vanishes into the blue sky. Cô Phàm's harbour, emptied when the fleet was lost.

places.name: Cô Thành
places.note: Vương Xương Linh, the poet of Băng Tâm: the lone fortress looks far toward the jade gate. Destroyed in the Desert Road War.

places.name: Châu Lệ Cảng
places.note: Lý Thương Ẩn: the pearl in the moonlit sea has tears. Burned by Thôn Hải's raiders.

places.name: Thiết Tỏa Quan
places.note: Lưu Vũ Tích: the thousand-fathom iron chain sank to the river bed. The Tùng Đào and Lạc Hà fort that Thiên Xu broke in the War of the Pivot.

places.name: Thu Phần Các
places.note: Lý Hạ: thu phần quỷ xướng Bão gia thi, ghosts sing old poems in the autumn graves. A bamboo hill 10 tiles from the ruins of Lôi Trạch Thành.

places.name: Phục Hổ Cương
places.note: A tiger-kind beast's ridge on the Kinh Trập highland, where the storms wake the hills.

places.name: Vạn Xà Lâm
places.note: Deep jungle at the far end of Đan Huyệt Châu, the farthest lair from any town.

places.name: Tuyết Lang Nguyên
places.note: Tundra of Hàn Sương Châu where the snow wolves run in packs.

places.name: Bằng Sào Nhai
places.note: A roc nests on the cliffs of Dao Quang Lĩnh.

places.name: Huyền Viên Lâm
places.note: Jungle below the wutong hills of Thê Ngô Lĩnh, held by dark apes.

places.name: Thương Ưng Đài
places.note: The high plateau of Thiên Tuyền Nguyên, hunting ground of the grey hawks, near Chiết Kích Nguyên.

places.name: Hắc Hùng Lĩnh
places.note: Highland of Tiêu Vũ Lâm where the black bears den.

places.name: Thiết Bối Cốc
places.note: Beasts with iron backs feed on the ore of Ngọc Hành Sơn.

places.name: Hàn Giao Chử
places.note: A lone islet far north of Ngọc Hồ Sơn where a cold giao coils.

places.name: Băng Tê Nguyên
places.note: Tundra of Thanh Loan Lĩnh crossed by ice rhinoceroses.

places.name: Vụ Báo Lâm
places.note: Jungle of Cô Vụ Đảo, the lonely misty island, where leopards hunt in the mist.

places.name: Hổ Khiếu Cương
places.note: A ridge between the nine bends of Cửu Khúc Xuyên where a tiger's roar carries.

places.name: Thiên Chu Lâm
places.note: Jungle of Thu Thủy Loan webbed by poison spiders.

places.name: Hỏa Hồ Nguyên
places.note: Tundra of Tuyết Hỏa Giác, the horn of snow and fire, where fire foxes run on the snow.

places.name: Tuyết Để Tuyền
places.note: Hot water rising under the snowfields of Tuyết Hỏa Giác.

places.name: Noãn Ngọc Tuyền
places.note: A warm spring in the frost land of Hàn Sương Châu, its stones warm to the touch.

places.name: Hồ Tâm Thang
places.gloss: Hot Water at the Lake's Heart
places.note: Hot springs on an island in the lake of Tuyết Hỏa Giác.

places.name: Chu Sa Tuyền
places.note: A red hot spring in the jungle of Đan Huyệt Châu, the phoenix's cinnabar land.

places.name: Ngọc Nhũ Tuyền
places.note: Warm water among the stone pillars of Ngư Ca Xuyên's karst.

places.name: Xích Viêm Khẩu
places.note: A vent of the volcano in Ngọc Hành Sơn.

places.name: Niết Hỏa Khẩu
places.note: In Thê Ngô Lĩnh, the wutong hills where the phoenix is reborn in fire.

places.name: Hàn Diễm Khẩu
places.note: A vent high on Ngọc Hồ Sơn, fire under the ice of Băng Tâm's land.

places.name: Chúc Dung Khẩu
places.note: Named for the fire god; a vent on the east coast of Đan Huyệt Châu.

places.name: Lôi Ngô Lâm
places.note: Wutong trees under the storm peaks of Thê Ngô Lĩnh, struck again and again.

tong_mon.name: Đệ tử tông môn
tong_mon.home: the region of the chosen sect's seat
tong_mon.start: at the seat, as an outer disciple

tan_tu.name: Tán tu
tan_tu.home: a region with a cultivator market (phường thị), where loose cultivators gather

gia_toc.name: Con cháu gia tộc
gia_toc.home: the region of the clan's town, one clan in each great sect's land

choices.note: Lưu Vũ Tích: cựu thời Vương Tạ đường tiền yến, phi nhập tầm thường bách tính gia, the swallows of the old Vương and Tạ halls now nest in common homes. A great house fallen to a small clan, and the Vương clan's old rival.
The other house of the same line. Far from the Tạ now, in Phượng Minh's rice plain.
A coast clan of the white sands, on Thúy Vi's far west shore.
A farming clan of good harvests under Thính Vũ's rain.
A clan of the twin bridges on Thiên Xu's river road.
A clan of the deer-call forest under Tùng Đào's pines.
A clan in the locust shade of the cold north, under Lê Hoa Am.

gia_toc.start: in the clan's town, with its field already growing
